title: InfiCoEvalChain: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized Framework for Collaborative LLM Evaluation
reasoning: The paper presents a decentralized framework for LLM evaluation to address stochasticity and hardware variance. It tests models on standard technical benchmarks (GSM8K, HumanEval, LiveCodeBench, GPQA, and MMLU). While it mentions social biases as a motivation for improved evaluation reliability, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
